channel.title: Gujuri Alekha
channel.description: Hands-on AI, data science and machine learning tutorials in Python: runnable notebooks on time series, statistics and ML, step by step.

item.title: White Noise and Random Walks in Time Series Analysis
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Learn how to identify White Noise and Random Walk processes in financial time series using visual, ACF/PACF, and Ljung-Box test diagnostics.

item.title: Stationarity in Time Series Analysis
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Learn how to detect non-stationarity in time series using statistical tests and apply techniques like differencing, transformations, and detrending to achieve stationarity.

item.title: Time Series Analysis and Decomposition
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Learn the fundamentals of time series forecasting, additive vs. multiplicative models, and robust STL decomposition using NIFTY 50 data.

item.title: Python Basics: Variables and Data Types
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: An introduction to Python, its interpreters, and core data types: numbers, strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries and basic operators.

item.title: Python Control Flow: if, elif, else and Loops
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Learn how Python makes decisions and repeats work with if, elif and else statements, for and while loops, and break and continue.

item.title: Python Functions and Modules
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Define and call Python functions, pass arguments, return values, and import modules and libraries such as math.

item.title: Python Data Structures: Lists, Sets and Comprehensions
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Work with Python lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets and frozensets, write list comprehensions, and sort and search collections.

item.title: Python File Handling: Reading and Writing Files
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Read and write text files in Python, choose the right file mode, and use the with statement to close files safely.

item.title: Python Exceptions: try, except and finally
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Handle errors in Python with try, except and finally, raise custom exceptions, and understand the exception class hierarchy.

item.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in Python
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Learn classes and objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, and method overriding and overloading in Python.

item.title: Working with Data in Python: CSV, JSON and Pandas
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: Read and write CSV, JSON and XML data in Python, manipulate it with pandas, and visualize it with Matplotlib and Seaborn.

item.title: Python Web Development: Flask and Django Basics
item.dc:creator: Gujuri Alekha
item.description: An introduction to Python web frameworks Flask and Django: routing, templates, databases, and HTTP requests and responses.
